# CANDIDATE: CLOSING_AUCTION_IMBALANCE_DRIFT

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The closing auction imbalance (market-on-close order flow) predicts short-term drift in the final 15 minutes, allowing a directional scalp into the close. This edge exists because institutional order flow imbalances during the auction phase often persist through the close due to liquidity constraints and delayed execution.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If Closing_Auction_Imbalance > 0.6 × average daily volume (bullish) AND time ≥ 15:45 EST, then enter long at the market price one minute before close (or VWAP of the last 5 min); if Imbalance < -0.6 × average daily volume (bearish), enter short similarly. Exit shape: Exit at the market close (15:59 EST); no trailing stop or profit target – the trade is time-based. Regime hint: Effective when VIX spot < 25 to limit gap risk and on days without major scheduled news (filter by time-of-day after 15:30).
